sanskrit_verse:
यावन्तश्च ऋतवस् तस्याः समतीता पतिं विना।
तावत्यो भ्रूणहत्याः स्युस् तस्य यो न ददाति ताम्॥
transliteration: yāvantaś ca ṛtavaḥ tasyāḥ samatītā patiṁ vinā | tāvatyo bhruṇahatyāḥ syus tasya yo na dadāti tām ||
sph_interpretive_translation: For every menstrual cycle a woman has undergone without union with her husband, if conception was prevented or destroyed by him, that many counts of fetal destruction are incurred by the man who withholds the completion of procreative responsibility.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from capacity to sustain creation, not mere biological function.
Causation is established through conscious withholding of procreative completion.
Capacity-based responsibility includes the duty to enable natural manifestation.
Restoration logic requires re-alignment with generative dharma.
Consciousness alignment demands recognition of life-force continuity.
executable_legal_axioms: IF male partner prevents conception OR destroys embryo AND has knowledge of female's unjoined cycles THEN liability equals number of uninterrupted menstrual periods.
IF conception denied due to willful interference THEN restoration protocol activates proportional to reproductive denial count.
IF pati-vratā (husband-bound duty) violated THEN automatic initiation of integrity-reintegration process.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes threshold of reproductive responsibility based on measurable biological cycles. The court must recognize that withholding procreation unlawfully incurs quantifiable karmic liability equivalent to natural rhythm disruption. Authority lies in aligning verdicts with prakriti’s sequential unfoldment, not punitive constructs.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals causality rooted in obstructed generative flow. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows sequential unfolding of fertility denied. Proportional responsibility reflects exact measure of interrupted rhythms. Non-punitive reality rule mandates restoration through conscious realignment, not suffering induction.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Pati-Vrata Reintegration Process to restore procreative harmony.
Activate Bija-Shuddhi Completion Protocol to purify generative intent.
Enforce Ritvikta Dharmopadesha until full reproductive alignment is restored.
Assign Tapobhūmi Seva for duration equaling disrupted menstrual cycles.
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed. Dharma is restored through recognition of procreative responsibility as consciousness service. Reality remains non-punitive when guided by Sanatana Vidhi. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth beyond form.
